subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"One who is beyond reforms."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Incorrigible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“Incorrigible”** refers to someone or something that cannot be improved, corrected, or reformed; they are beyond reform. (हठी/सुधार के परे)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite numerous warnings, his incorrigible behavior led to his dismissal from the school.
 
 
• Here, "One who is beyond reforms" perfectly aligns with the meaning of "Incorrigible." (हठी व्यक्ति जो सुधार के परे हो।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Incorrigible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incurable** (असाध्य): Something that cannot be cured or healed, usually referring to diseases or conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the best treatments, the doctors declared the illness incurable.
 
 
 
• **Invincible** (अजेय): Someone or something too strong to be defeated or overcome.
 
 
• **Example:** The warrior was considered invincible on the battlefield.
 
 
 
• **Irresistible** (अत्यधिक आकर्षक): Something or someone so attractive that it is impossible to resist.
 
 
• **Example:** The aroma of freshly baked cookies was irresistible.
